project.name: Castellan Ledger
project.description: An event-sourced, CQRS double-entry banking ledger: an immutable event log as the source of truth, idempotent command handling, saga orchestration for multi-account transfers, read-model projections, the transactional outbox pattern for reliable event publishing, reconciliation against external statements, a rule-based antifraud pipeline, multi-tenancy, and a full audit trail. Hexagonal architecture: domain has no framework dependency at all.
